design.what: the manual grew with every version after v3.40 — seven lessons in v3.49 make it 93 pages, the floor the check holds
the parcels addressed: the board posts one run per door the shelf names (pc_<from>_<to>), each carrying what is addressed there, not one run for the nearest lit town
accepted, the shelf keeps what is addressed elsewhere; what went on the pack leaves it and is not reposted
the wedge card is the Party card (the plain names)
the storm brings the camp's own by trade (the first three of its roll); the check stages the three as plain knives to read the v3.40 walk
